scripts.dev: npm run setup:emscripten && npm run wasm:generate && vite dev --host 0.0.0.0
scripts.build: npm run setup:emscripten && npm run wasm:generate && vite build
scripts.build:dev: NODE_ENV=development npm run setup:emscripten && npm run wasm:generate && vite build
scripts.ios: npm run build:dev && npm run sync && npx cap run ios
scripts.ios:phone: npm run build:dev && npm run sync && npx cap open ios
scripts.ios:sim: npm run build:dev && npm run sync && npx cap run ios --target=7CFDC71F-C7F2-4755-B460-278906924787
scripts.android: npm run build:dev && npm run sync && npx cap run android
scripts.clear-cache: rm -rf .svelte-kit node_modules/.vite build docs && echo '✅ All caches cleared!'
scripts.esp32:full: npm run esp32:upload && npm run esp32:monitor
scripts.wasm:full: npm run wasm:generate && npm run wasm:build
scripts.operators:add: echo 'To add a new operator: 1) Create .cpp file in src/native/operators/, 2) Run npm run wasm:generate to auto-generate registry, 3) Run npm run wasm:build'
